coverage.not_supported: Cross-border is supported for equity income only: /cross-border-equity splits an RSU vest or option exercise between countries by workdays (OECD) or the country's own rule and estimates the tax on each share for Singapore, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, Ireland, India; it does not compute treaty rates or the double-tax relief, and cross-border salary withholding (multi-country payroll) is not supported yet. Equity compensation tax (/equity-tax) covers United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Canada, India; supplemental withholding (/supplemental-withholding: bonus, commission, RSU vest, option exercise, lump sum) covers Singapore, France, Netherlands, Spain, Germany, United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, Ireland, India.
coverage.summary: 217 countries with official tax tables; 15 with take-home pay calculations; 14 with employer cost; 15 in the cross-country comparison (France: take-home pay and compare only, no employer cost yet); 12 with supplemental (bonus) withholding; 5 with equity compensation tax (RSUs and stock options); 10 with cross-border equity estimates for mobile employees.
